{{External|rs|rsc}} {{Otheruses|cooked shark|the raw form|raw shark|other shark items/NPCs|Shark (disambiguation)}} {{Infobox Item |name = Shark |image = [[File:Shark.png]] |release = [[27 February]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (27 February 2002) |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |edible = Yes |options = Eat, Drop |examine = I'd better be careful eating this. |value = 170 |weight = 0.650 |exchange = Yes |id = 385 }} [[File:Shark detail.png|left|150px]] '''Shark''' is a type of [[fish]] that restores 20 [[Hitpoints]] when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking [[raw shark]] on a [[fire]] or [[cooking range]], requiring level 80 [[Cooking]] and granting 210 [[experience]] when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a [[burnt shark]]. The [[burn rate]] decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. It will only stop burning entirely if the player is wearing a [[Cooking cape]], or using [[Cooking gauntlets]] at level 94 (84 if elite [[Kourend & Kebos Diary]] is completed while cooking at the [[Hosidius Kitchen|Hosidius kitchen]]). When eaten, the message {{Mes|You eat the shark.}} is displayed. In addition to being cooked or purchased from other players, sharks can be obtained from [[Bardur]] in the [[Waterbirth Island Dungeon]], who will exchange one shark for a [[Fremennik blade]], [[Fremennik helm]], or [[Fremennik shield]]. Fishing and cooking 5 sharks with the [[cooking gauntlets]] in Catherby is a requirement for the [[Kandarin Diary|Kandarin elite diary]]. ==Creation== {{Recipe|skill1=Cooking|skill1lvl=80|skill1boostable=Yes|skill1exp=210|members=Yes|ticks=4|facilities=Cooking range|mat1=Raw shark|output1=Shark}} ===Cooking chance=== {{Skilling success chart|label=Shark cooking chance|showbefore=no |label1=Fire|low1=1|high1=202|req1=80|color1=orange|image1=Firemaking icon.png |label2=Range|low2=1|high2=232|req2=80|color2=saddlebrown|image2=Cooking range icon.png |label3=Gauntlets|low3=15|high3=270|req3=80|color3=grey|image3=Cooking gauntlets.png |label4=Hosidius +5%|low4=13|high4=244|req4=80|color4=red|image4=Cooking range icon.png |label5=Hosidius +10%|low5=26|high5=257|req5=80|color5=blue|image5=Cooking range icon.png |label6=Hosidius +5%, gauntlets|low6=27|high6=282|req6=80|color6=#ffcccb|image6=Cooking gauntlets.png |label7=Hosidius +10%, gauntlets|low7=40|high7=295|req7=80|color7=#ccccff|image7=Cooking gauntlets.png }} ==Money making== {{Mmgsection|Cooking raw sharks}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Shark}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Shark}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 20 September 2018 |update = Deadman Experience Cap Increase and Quality of Life Changes |poll = |change = The [[value]] was changed from 300 to 170 so that it would appear below more valuable items when on the ground. }} {{Subject changes |date = 17 July 2007 |update = Game Improvements (July 2007) |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Shark detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Shark detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Shark (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Shark.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 ⁠–
